# `/suggested-entitlement-descriptions` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /suggested-entitlement-descriptions/v1/auto-write-settings

`getAutoWriteSettingsV1` — Get auto-write settings for SED

Get the current auto-write configuration for the tenant, including the enabled state and source include/exclude lists.

- Scopes: idn:sed:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Returns 200: autowritesettingresponse

### POST /suggested-entitlement-descriptions/v1/auto-write-settings

`createAutoWriteSettingsV1` — Create auto-write settings for SED

Create the initial auto-write settings for a tenant. Returns 409 Conflict if settings already exist. Use PATCH to update existing settings.

- Scopes: idn:sed:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): autowritesetting
- Returns 201: autowritesettingresponse

### PATCH /suggested-entitlement-descriptions/v1/auto-write-settings

`updateAutoWriteSettingsV1` — Update auto-write settings for SED

Partially update the auto-write settings for a tenant using JSON Patch operations. Only the "replace" operation is supported. Returns 404 if no settings exist yet - use POST to create them first.

- Scopes: idn:sed:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of autowritesettingpatch
- Returns 200: autowritesettingresponse

### GET /suggested-entitlement-descriptions/v1

`listSedsV1` — List suggested entitlement descriptions

List of Suggested Entitlement Descriptions (SED) SED field descriptions: **batchId**: the ID of the batch of entitlements that are submitted for description generation **displayName**: the display name of the entitlement that we are generating a description for **sourceName**: the name of the source associated with the entitlement that we are generating the description for **sourceId**: the ID of the source associated with the entitlement that we are generating the description for **status**:…

- Scopes: idn:sed:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: batchId: eq, ne; displayName: eq, ne, co; sourceName: eq, ne, co; sourceId: eq, ne; status: eq, ne; fullText: co — e.g. `displayName co "Read and Write"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: displayName, sourceName, status — e.g. `sorters=displayName`
  - `count-only` (query) — default False — If `true` it will populate the `X-Total-Count` response header with the number of results that would be returned if `limit` and `offset` were ignored. This parameter differs from the count parameter…
  - `requested-by-anyone` (query) — default False — By default, the ListSeds API will only return items that you have requested to be generated. This option will allow you to see all items that have been requested
  - `show-pending-status-only` (query) — default False — Will limit records to items that are in "suggested" or "approved" status
- Returns 200: array of sed

### PATCH /suggested-entitlement-descriptions/v1

`patchSedV1` — Patch suggested entitlement description

Patch Suggested Entitlement Description

- Scopes: idn:sed:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — id is sed id
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of sedpatch
- Returns 200: sed
